Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans, building ages, classroom counts, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment using CEFPI standards with detailed immediate, future, and long-term needs and cost estimates for all major systems across all sites (Sections 6, pages 69-240).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections by grade and site through 2021 with demographic analysis, housing development impact, and capacity utilization by site; explicit connection of projections to facility needs including new school sites and boundary adjustments (Sections 4, pages 41-56).

Educational Alignment.justification: Includes educational specifications with detailed space standards aligned to district goals; discusses CTE programs and specialized classrooms; connects facility projects to educational programs but coverage of programmatic shifts and integration is partial (Sections 3, 5, 14-20).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: References outdoor spaces such as playfields and hardcourts with some site maps; mentions deficiencies in playfield and hardcourt areas at multiple campuses but lacks districtwide data or comprehensive greening strategies (Facility assessments, site plans).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges health and safety upgrades including fire safety and emergency lighting but does not provide detailed climate risk assessments or comprehensive climate resilience strategies (Immediate and long-term needs sections).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy-related upgrades such as LED lighting replacements, HVAC system upgrades, and electrical capacity improvements; references state requirements and energy resilience goals but lacks fully comprehensive districtwide energy resilience strategy (Immediate and future needs across campuses).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed financial plan with itemized cost estimates, phased project prioritization, multiple funding sources including Measure V bond and state funds, and long-term capital strategy aligned with district priorities (Section 7, pages 241-243).
